name: search_listings
description: Search local public inventory by cooking equipment and return up to six candidates with explicit equipment evidence and unknowns. Requires a state unless the buyer has agreed to a nationwide search. Never treats a cuisine-title miss or incomplete query as no local supply.

keywords.description: Specific search words when not using a cooking concept. Equipment terms are preferred over cuisine names.

food_concept.description: What they plan to cook, e.g. tacos, burgers, fried food, pizza, coffee or barbecue. Maps menu intent to actual listed equipment; missing details remain unconfirmed.

required_equipment.description: Additional equipment the buyer says is mandatory, comma separated, e.g. fryer, refrigerator. Do not invent must-haves.

city.description: Buyer city, used to prefer same-city candidates within their state. Ask about travel before calling another city nearby.

search_scope.description: Defaults to local. Use nationwide only after the buyer agrees or originally requests national inventory.

max_price.description: Highest sale price (or daily rate for rentals) in US dollars. Optional.

min_price.description: Lowest price in US dollars. Optional.

state.description: US state code or full name for the local search, e.g. TX or Texas. Required for local inventory.

ships_nationwide.description: Only for-sale listings that ship anywhere in the US with Vendibook Freight. Use only after the buyer agrees to widen to nationwide shipping.

name: show_listing
description: Open a listing page on the buyer's screen and return its details (equipment, condition, delivery options, whether offers are accepted).

listing_id.description: The listing id from search_listings, or its result number (1 = first result), or "current" for the listing on their screen.

name: get_delivery_quote
description: Get the delivery options and quote totals for a listing to the buyer's ZIP code. Returns totals only.

listing_id.description: The listing id from search_listings, or its result number (1 = first result), or "current" for the listing on their screen.

name: start_request_to_buy
description: Take the buyer to the Request to buy page for a sale listing (or the booking section for a rental). The buyer reviews and sends it themselves.

listing_id.description: The listing id from search_listings, or its result number (1 = first result), or "current" for the listing on their screen.

name: draft_offer
description: Open the Make offer form for a sale listing, prefilled with the amount (and an optional note). The buyer reviews and sends it.

listing_id.description: The listing id from search_listings, or its result number (1 = first result), or "current" for the listing on their screen.

amount.description: Offer amount in US dollars, below the asking price.

note.description: Optional short, polite note to the seller.

name: draft_seller_message
description: Open a message to the seller prefilled with a draft (e.g. asking about price flexibility, delivery or a video walkthrough). The buyer edits and sends it.

listing_id.description: The listing id from search_listings, or its result number (1 = first result), or "current" for the listing on their screen.

message.description: The draft message, written in the buyer's voice, friendly and short.

name: send_seller_message
description: Send the message currently shown on the buyer's screen (from draft_seller_message) to the seller through Vendibook messages. Only for signed-in buyers, and only after the buyer clearly said yes to sending that exact draft.

listing_id.description: The listing the draft is for (id, result number, or "current").

buyer_approved.description: True only if the buyer just clearly said yes to sending this draft.

name: estimate_earnings
description: Simple sales math from the buyer's own numbers. Returns monthly sales and sales after food cost, before all other expenses. Not a prediction.

avg_ticket.description: Average sale per customer in US dollars.

food_cost_percent.description: Food and packaging cost as a percent of sales, e.g. 30.

equipment_price.description: Optional price of the truck or trailer, to compare against.

name: get_permit_requirements
description: Look up curated government-source mobile food requirements before answering permit, health, commissary, fire or zoning questions. Returns jurisdiction scope, source links, review date and coverage gaps. Not a live agency approval.

city.description: Actual operating city, not the listing location or a broad region.

state.description: Operating US state, full name or two-letter code.

county.description: Operating county, if known; city boundaries and base county matter.

operation.description: Known preparation method, menu, truck/cart, fuel and private site/public space/event; do not invent missing facts.

name: get_faq
description: Look up Vendibook's official support policy (owner master guide) for policy questions: fees, payouts, refunds, deposits, cancellations, disputes, invoices, offers, Pro, BuyerMatch, verification, shipping, financing, accounts and support.

question.description: The buyer's question in plain words, e.g. "when does the seller get paid" or "can I pay cash".

name: get_pricing
description: Current Vendibook fees (listing, sale commission, rental fees) and optional seller upgrades with live prices. Call before quoting any fee or price.

name: open_page
description: Open a Vendibook page on the buyer's screen.

page.description: Which page. "sell" starts a new listing, "my_listings" is the seller's own listings, "permits" opens the PermitPath planner, "permit_sources" opens the government-source library, "pricing" shows fees and upgrades, "insurance" is the FLIP insurance partner page, "account" is Dashboard → Account (where Close account is).

search_text.description: Optional search text when page is "search".

name: look_at_page
description: See what is on the buyer's screen right now: the page, its sections (headings) and the buttons, links, tabs and fields on it, each with a ref. Controls marked buyer_only (send, pay, submit, sign in, accept, buy, save) are for the buyer to press. Call this before page_action, and again after the page changes.

name: page_action
description: Act on the buyer's screen like a person pointing at it: scroll to a section, highlight something, read a section's text, press a safe button or tab (photos, tabs, show more, filters, open a section), or type into a search, ZIP or filter field. Never presses buyer_only controls or types into payment, login or contact fields — those get highlighted for the buyer instead.

target.description: A ref from look_at_page (like "s3" or "c12"). For scroll it can also be "up", "down", "top" or "bottom".

value.description: For fill: the text to type (e.g. a ZIP code or search words) or the option to pick.

press_enter.description: For fill on a search or ZIP field: also run the search.

name: request_follow_up
description: Set up a follow-up from a real person on the Vendibook team, due within 2 business hours (Mon–Fri 8 AM–8 PM ET). Notifies the admins and emails support@vendibook.com. Returns the follow-up time and a reference number to read back.

phone.description: Best phone number to reach them, if they gave one.

email.description: Email to reach them, if they gave one. Signed-in members can leave it out.

preferred_contact.description: How they prefer to be reached.

topic.description: A few words on what it is about, e.g. "financing on the Houston taco trailer".

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what they want, what you already covered, and any listing, budget, ZIP or timing they mentioned.

name: talk_to_person
description: Hand the buyer to a real person on the Vendibook team: opens live chat on their screen (or the contact page if chat is offline).

reason.description: Short summary of what they need help with.
